title: A nonzero etale module-sheaf section bounds the scheme universe
statement: Let $u,v,w$ be universes, $X$ a scheme in universe $u$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and $\Lambda$ a commutative ring in universe $v$. Let $F$ be a sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on the small etale site of $X$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], with section modules in universe $\max(v,w)$. If an etale object $U$ has a section $s\in F(U)$ with $s\ne0$, then every type $A$ in universe $u$ is equivalent to a type in universe $\max(v,w)$ (Lean: $\mathrm{UnivLE}^{u,\max(v,w)}$). No quasi-compactness, filtered diagram, or colimit is assumed.

source.place: Sites Definition Tag 00VR (definition-sheaf), applied to the disjoint union cover; Schemes Tags 01JB and 01JC (lemma-glue and lemma-glue-schemes). The size consequence is written by S1.

proof.text: For any type A in the scheme universe, form the disjoint union V of copies of U indexed by A. Its structure map to X is etale by locality at the source. Its summand inclusions form a covering family, with pairwise disjoint images.

Put E=F(U). For each a in A prescribe maps E to F(U) equal to the identity on summand a and zero on other summands. These maps are compatible: on the same summand use monicity of its inclusion; a common source of distinct summands is empty, whose section module is terminal by the empty covering. Apply the module-valued sheaf condition to obtain t(a): E to F(V).

If t(a)=t(b) with a different from b, restrict to summand a to obtain id_E=0. Evaluation at s contradicts s nonzero. Thus t embeds A in the type of maps E to F(V), a type in the coefficient universe. Mathlib small_of_injective gives Small A. Since A was arbitrary this is UnivLE. Empty A causes no problem; empty U or the zero ring cannot have a nonzero section.

If some étale object $U$ has a section $s\in F(U)$ with $s\ne0$, then universe $u$ is no larger than universe $\max(v,w)$: every type in universe $u$ is in bijection with a type in universe $\max(v,w)$. proof.text: Let $A$ be any type in universe $u$. Form the disjoint union $V=\coprod_{a\in A}U$ of copies of $U$ indexed by $A$, a scheme in universe $u$. Its structure map to $X$ is etale, being etale on each summand (etaleness is local on the source), and the summand inclusions form an etale covering of $V$ whose images are pairwise disjoint.

Put $E=F(U)$. For each $a\in A$ prescribe, on the summand indexed by $b\in A$, the $\Lambda$-linear map $E\to F(U)$ which is the identity if $b=a$ and zero if $b\ne a$. This family is compatible for the covering: the fibre product of a summand with itself is that summand, as summand inclusions are monomorphisms, and the fibre product of two distinct summands is empty, while $F(\emptyset)=0$ by the sheaf condition for the empty covering. The sheaf condition for $F$ therefore gives a $\Lambda$-linear map $t(a):E\to F(V)$ whose restriction to the summand $b$ is the prescribed map.
